Moreover the four lords lack posthumous-elevation rite—this clarifies they should be destroyed without sacrifice.” At that time Prince of Kuaiji as regional commander, with Masters of Writing aide Liu Shao and others memorialized: “Four ancestors together dwell in western distant shrine, storing tablets in stone chamber; di and yin offerings follow former court’s old observance.” At the time Fan Xuan of Chenliu, his nephew asked this rite; Xuan replied: “What Shun’s temple sacrifices are all commoners; later generations distant then destroyed, not dwelling above Shun, not ordering bright and somber. Now the four lords’ titles still follow their originals—not merit-based elevation to sacrifice. If following Yu’s burying of main tablet, then still burying in descendants’ precinct; if following Xia’s burying of main tablet, then again not on original temple’s steps. It is fitting to ponder the change—then build one chamber: while kin affection has not ended, at di and yin place them above Emperor Xuan; when affection ends they have no reason to descend among grandsons’ rows.” Officials coalesced on Cai’s east-facing rite. Erudite Zhang Ping proposed: “Some doubt that arraying before dynastic founder means all later destroyed tablets—Ping examines ancient meaning—there is no text distinguishing earlier and later. Yu did not rank before Gun—then moved tablet dwelling above dynastic founder—what doubt remains?” Jingzhao joined the western distant-shrine storage; eleven main bays remained. Brother successions skipped a removal round. Sima Yu’s line restored two tablets. Another cycle removed Yingchuan.
64
孝武帝太元十二年五月壬戌，詔曰：「昔建太廟，每事從儉，太祖虛位，明堂未建。 郊祀國之大事，而稽古之制闕然，便可詳議。」 祠部郎中徐邈議：「圓丘郊祀，經典無二，宣皇帝嘗辯斯義，而檢以聖典。 爰及中興，備加研極，以定南北二郊，誠非異學所可輕改也。 謂仍舊為安。 武皇帝建廟六世，祖三昭三穆。 宣皇帝創基之主，實惟太祖，親則王考。 四廟在上，未及遷世，故權虛東向之位也。 兄弟相及，義非二世。 故當今廟祀，世數未足，而欲太祖正位，則違事七之義矣。 又《禮》曰庶子王亦禘祖立廟，蓋謂支胤援立，則親近必復。 京兆府君於今六世，宜復立此室，則宣皇未在六世之上，須前世既遷，乃太祖位定耳。 京兆遷毀宜藏主於石室，雖禘祫猶弗及。 何者？ 傳稱毀主升合乎太祖，升者自下之名，不謂可降尊就卑也。 太子太孫，陰室四主，儲嗣之重，升祔皇祖，所配之廟，世遠應遷，然後從食之孫，與之俱毀。 明堂方圓之制，綱領已舉，不宜闕配帝之祀。 且王者以天下為家，未必一邦，故周平、光武無廢於二京也。 明堂所配之神，積疑莫辯。 案《易》'殷薦上帝，以配祖考'，祖考同配，則上帝亦為天，而嚴父之義顯。 《周禮》旅上帝者，有故告天，與郊祀常禮同用四圭，故並言之。 若上帝是五帝，《經》文何不言祀天旅五帝，祀地旅四望乎？」 侍中車胤議同。 又曰：「明堂之制，既其難詳，且樂主於和，禮主於敬，故質文不同，音器亦殊。 既茅茨廣夏，不一其度，何必守其形範，而不弘本從俗乎？ 九服咸寧，河朔無塵，然後明堂辟雍可崇而修之。」 時朝議多同，於是奉行，一無所改。 十六年，始改作太廟殿，正室十四間，東西儲各一間，合十六間，棟高八丈四尺。 備法駕遷神主於行廟，征西至京兆四主及太子太孫各用其位之儀服。 四主不從帝者之儀，是與太康異也。 諸主既入廟，設脯醢之奠。 及新廟成，神主還室，又設脯醢之奠。 十九年二月，追尊簡文母會稽太妃鄭氏為簡文皇帝宣太后，立廟太廟道西。 及孝武崩，京兆又遷，如穆帝之世四祧故事。
Xiaowudi, Taiyuan 12 fifth month renxu, edict said: “Formerly building grand temple, each affair followed frugality—dynastic founder’s seat empty, Bright Hall not yet built. Suburban sacrifice is the state’s great affair, yet examining antiquity’s system is lacking—now may deliberate in detail.” Sacrifices section director Xu Miao proposed: “Round mound suburban sacrifice, classics are not dual—Emperor Xuan once debated this meaning, checking against sage canon. Down to restoration, fully plumb extremes, thereby fixing south and north two suburbs—truly not a heterodox school may lightly alter. We say keeping the old is secure. Martial Emperor built temple for six generations—three bright three somber. Emperor Xuan is the founder who laid base—truly the dynastic founder—by affection he is royal father. Four temples above, not yet reaching removal generations—hence provisionally empty the east-facing position. Brothers succeeding one another, in meaning is not two generations. Hence today’s temple sacrifice, generation count not yet sufficient, yet desiring dynastic founder’s correct position—then violates serving seven’s meaning. Moreover the Rites says when a bastard-line king also performs di to ancestor and builds temple, it means when a side heir is raised, close lines must return. Jingzhao lord is now six generations—fitting again to erect this chamber—then Emperor Xuan is not yet above six generations; must wait until prior generations have moved—only then is dynastic founder’s position fixed. Jingzhao’s removal and destruction—it is fitting to hide tablets in a stone chamber—even at di and yin they still do not reach them. For what reason? Tradition says destroyed tablets ascend to join the dynastic founder—“ascend” names motion from below—it does not mean one may lower honor to humble rank. Crown prince and eldest grandson, four masters in the yin chamber—weight of heir succession—ascending to join imperial grandfather; the temple they pair with, generations distant, ought to move—then grandsons who shared food with them are destroyed together. Bright Hall’s square-round design—outline already raised—it is not fitting to omit cult of the god who is paired. Moreover kings take all under heaven as home—not necessarily one state—hence Zhou Ping and Guangwu were not faulted for two capitals. The spirit Bright Hall pairs with—accumulated doubts unresolved. Examining the Changes “Yin offering to the Supreme Lord, pairing ancestors and fathers”—ancestors and fathers paired together—then the Supreme Lord is also Heaven, and the meaning of honoring father as supreme appears. The Rites of Zhou’s “marshal the Supreme Lord” means occasional report to heaven—same as suburban sacrifice’s constant rite—using the four-pointed jade—hence spoken together. If the Supreme Lord were the Five Emperors, why does scripture not say “sacrifice to heaven and marshal the Five Emperors, sacrifice to earth and marshal the four wang”?” Che Yin concurred. He also said: “Bright Hall’s form, already hard to detail—moreover music roots in harmony, rite roots in reverence—hence plainness and ornament differ, tones and instruments differ. Since thatch huts and broad halls do not share one measure, why cling to outward mold and not enlarge the root and follow custom? When the nine domains are all calm and Hebei free of dust, then Bright Hall and circular moat may be exalted and built.” The court tabled major reform. Taiyuan 16 expanded the hall to sixteen bays. Procession matched Taikang except for four lords’ reduced pomp. Western Jin had given those tablets full imperial escort; Jin did not. Interim offerings marked installation. Second offering marked final seating. Sima Yu’s mother received a chapel beside the main line. Another emperor’s death cycled Jingzhao into western storage like before.
65
義熙九年四月，將殷祠，詔博議遷毀之禮。 大司馬琅邪王德文議：「泰始之初，虛太祖之位，而緣情流遠，上及征西，故世盡則宜毀，而宣帝正太祖之位。 又漢光武移十一帝主於洛邑，則毀主不設，理可推矣。 宜築別室，以居四府君之主，永藏而弗祀也。」 大司農徐廣議：「四府君嘗處廟堂之首，歆率土之祭，若埋之幽壤，於情理未必咸盡。 謂可遷藏西儲，以為遠祧，而禘饗永絕也。」 太尉諮議參軍袁豹議：「仍舊無革，殷祠猶及四府君，情理為允。」 時劉裕作輔，意與大司馬議同，須後殷祠行事改制。 會安帝崩，未及禘而天祿終焉。
Liu Yu’s court reopened the tablet-storage fight. Grand marshal Prince of Langye Sima Dewen proposed: “Taishi’s opening left dynastic founder’s seat empty, yet affection flowed far up to General Who Conquers the West—hence when generations end they ought be destroyed and Emperor Xuan takes correct founder position. Moreover Han Guangwu moved eleven emperors’ tablets to Luoyang—then destroyed tablets were not set up—principle may be inferred. It is fitting to build separate chambers to house the four lords’ masters, eternally storing without sacrifice.” Minister of Finance Xu Guang proposed: “The four lords once stood at temple’s head, enjoying all-soil sacrifice—if buried in dark earth, sentiment and principle may not both be satisfied. We say they may be moved to western storage, taken as distant shrine, while di feasting ends forever.” Army consultant Yuan Bao proposed: “Keeping the old without reform—yin sacrifice still reaches four lords—sentiment and principle are balanced.” Liu Yu sided with Dewen but delayed action. Jin fell before the rite was settled.
66
武帝咸寧五年十一月己酉，弘訓羊太后崩，宗廟廢一時之祀，天地明堂去樂，且不上胙。 穆帝升平五年十月己卯，殷祀，以帝崩後不作樂。 孝武太元十一年九月，皇女亡，及應烝祠，中書侍郎范寧奏：「案《喪服傳》有死宮中者三月不舉祭，不別長幼之與貴賤也。 皇女雖在嬰孩，臣竊以為疑。」 於是尚書奏使三公行事。
National mourning silenced high cults and banquets. Court skipped music at yin after a death. Xiaowu, Taiyuan 11 ninth month, imperial daughter died—when autumn steam sacrifice fell due, palace secretary Fan Ning memorialized: “Examining Mourning Dress commentary, death inside palace halts sacrifice three months—without distinguishing elder or younger, noble or base. Though the imperial daughter was still an infant, your servant privately holds doubt.” Ministers delegated the steam rite to the three dukes.
67
武帝泰始七年四月，帝將親祠，車駕夕牲，而儀注還不拜。 詔問其故，博士奏歷代相承如此。 帝曰：「非致敬宗廟之禮也。」 於是實拜而還，遂以為制，夕牲必躬臨拜，而江左以來復止。
Evening victim inspection skipped the bow on exit. Scholars pleaded precedent. The emperor said: “This is not rite for reverently greeting the ancestral temple.” Western Jin made the bow norm; Eastern Jin dropped it again.
68
魏故事，天子為次殿於廟殿之北東，天子入自北門。 新禮，設次殿于南門中門外之右，天子入自南門。 摯虞以為：「次殿所以為解息之處，凡適尊以不顯為恭，以由隱為順，而設之於上位，入自南門，非謙厭之義。 宜定新禮，皆如舊說。」 從之。
Cao Wei kept a north-side robing room. Jin reform opened a southern approach. Zhi Yu held: “Resting hall is where one unties and rests—in all approaching the honored, not exposing is reverent, passing hidden is compliant—yet setting it in the upper position, entering from south gate—is not meaning of humble avoidance. It is fitting to fix new ritual entirely like old explanation.” Court agreed.
69
禮，大事則告祖禰，小事則特告禰，秦漢久廢。 魏文帝黃初四年七月，將東巡，以大軍當出，使太常以特牛告南郊。 及文帝崩，又使太尉告諡策於南郊。 自是迄晉相承，告郊之後仍以告廟，至江左其禮廢。 至成帝咸和三年，蘇峻覆亂京都，溫嶠等立行廟于白石，復行其典。 告先君及後曰：「逆臣蘇峻，傾覆社稷，毀棄三正。 污辱海內。 臣侃、臣嶠、臣亮等手刃戎首，龔行天罰。 惟中宗元皇帝、肅祖明皇帝、明穆皇后之靈，降鑒有罪，剿絕其命，翦此群凶，以安宗廟。 臣等雖隕首摧軀，猶生之年。」
Classical report rites lapsed in empire. Same campaign notice to heaven as before. Death also reported south of the city. Eastern Jin dropped temple announcement after suburb. Exile court revived report rites at a field shrine. Announcing to former lords and later said: “Rebel subject Su Jun overturned soil and grain, destroyed the three legitimacies. He defiled all within the seas. Your subjects Kan, Jiao, Liang and others personally beheaded the war-chief, executing heaven’s punishment. May spirits of Middle Ancestor Emperor Yuan, Revered Ancestor Emperor Ming, and Bright and Grave Empress look down on the guilty, cut off their fate, exterminate this pack of villains, to pacify the ancestral temple. Though your subjects lose heads and break bodies, it is still within our living years.”
70
魏明帝太和三年，詔曰：「禮，王后無嗣，擇建支子，以繼大宗，則當纂正統而奉公義，何得復顧私親哉！ 漢宣繼昭帝后，加悼考以皇號。 哀帝以外籓援立，而董宏等稱引亡秦，惑誤朝議，遂尊恭皇，立廟京師。 又寵籓妾，使比長信，僭差無禮，人神弗佑。 非罪師丹忠正之諫，用致丁傅焚如之禍。 自是之後，相踵行之。 其令公卿有司，深以前世為戒。 後嗣萬一有由諸侯入奉大統，則當明為人後之義。 敢為佞邪導諛君上，妄建非正之號，謂考為皇，稱妣為後，則股肱大臣誅之無赦。 其書之金策，藏之宗廟。」 是後高貴、常道援立，皆不外尊。 及湣帝建興四年，司徒梁芬議追尊之禮，帝既不從，而左僕射索綝等亦稱引魏制，以為不可，故追贈吳王為太保而已。 元帝太興二年，有司言琅邪恭王宜稱皇考。 賀循議云：「禮典之義，子不敢以己爵加其父號。」 帝又從之。
Wei Mingdi, Taihe 3, edict said: “Rite: when the queen lacks heir, choose and establish a collateral son to continue the great line—then one ought inherit correct line and uphold public duty—how may one again heed private kin! Han Xuandi, succeeding Emperor Zhao, added posthumous title “Mourned Father” with imperial style. Aidi, raised from outer fief, yet Dong Hong and others cited dead Qin, misleading court debate—thereupon they honored Respectful King, building temple in capital. They also favored a concubine-mother, comparing her to Dowager Changxin—usurpation and disorder without rite—men and spirits did not bless. Had it not been for Shi Dan’s loyal remonstrance, they would have brought Ding and Fu’s fire-brand calamity. From this onward they trod the path one after another. Order dukes and offices deeply take former ages as warning. If later heirs happen to enter the great line from a marquisate, then clarify the meaning of becoming another’s heir. Whoever dares flatter with heterodox paths, misleading the sovereign, rashly establishing illegitimate titles, calling father “emperor,” mother “empress”—then pillar ministers shall execute them without pardon. Inscribe it on metal book, store in ancestral temple.” Later Wei child emperors skipped private parent cults. Western Jin’s last emperor could not title his father emperor. Some wanted Sima Rui’s father elevated. He Xun argued: “Canon meaning—a son dares not add his own noble rank to his father’s title.” Sima Rui accepted restraint.
